Mr. S.K. Mandal, learned counsel for the applicant.
2. Mr. Rakesh Negi, learned Brief Holder for the State.

3. By means of present C528 application, applicant has put to challenge the charge-sheet dated 15.10.2023; cognizance and summoning order dated 18.04.2024 as well as the entire proceedings of Criminal Case No.3108 of 2024, State vs. Abdul Sattar & others, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 &
120-B IPC, pending in the court of learned Judicial Magistrate, Dehradun, qua the applicant.
4.
It is contended by learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is a bonafide transferee of the land of Jagat Prasad Sharma, husband of informant, by power of attorney of holder-Shri Anil Kumar.
He further contends that the land was gifted by power of attorney holder-Anil Kumar in favour of the applicant-Gyan Singh on 02.03.2019.

5. The first information report was lodged by respondent no.2-Smt. Usha Sharma on the premise that the land which was transferred to the Gyan Singh was a valuable land and may be sold on a higher price of Rs.60 lakhs, but the applicant has committed cheating and forgery with the husband of respondent no.2 and got land transferred by way of a gift deed.

6. It is contended by learned counsel for the applicant that instead of challenging the gift deed which allegedly has been executed in favour of applicant by power of attorney holder-Anil Kumar, the first information report has been lodged against the applicant, who was a bonafide transferee of the land.
He further submits that this is a case of civil nature deliberately given a colour of criminal case.
7. Learned State Counsel submits that he would file the counter affidavit to the C528 application.
